item.title: Show HN: Guitoro, a virtual guitar you strum with your keyboard
item.description:
📝 Play it with your computer keyboard, your left hand on the chords and your right hand strumming, or swipe the strings with your finger on a phone or tablet. Copy the shape onto your own guitar. Strum real chords and play whole songs with your computer keyboard or your fingers, with a backing band behind you.
🔗 Read more: https://guitoro.com/

item.description:

item.title: The United Kingdom generates less electricity per person than in the 1970s
item.description:
📝 But it’s still true that the UK consumes much less electricity than it used to. By 2025, this had fallen to less than 4%. The number of people living in extreme poverty has fallen from 140 million to about 10 million.
🔗 Read more: https://ourworldindata.org/data-insights/electricity-generation-per-person-in-the-united-kingdom-has-fallen-by-a-third-from-its-early-2000s-peak

item.title: Recreational Programming
item.description:
📝 Programming for the joy of programming itself - not for work, not for money, not for external requirements. Each represents a different path back to programming joy "The goal isn't to become any of these programmers. It's to remember why you started coding and keep that curiosity alive alongside your career.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cphiri.dev/presentations/recreational-programming

item.title: Physical Intelligence API Beta: Frontier Models for Every Robot
item.description:
📝 General-purpose robotic foundation models such as π0 and π0. What if the latest and most powerful robotic foundation models could be adapted to each application through a simple and ready-made API. But the range of real-world tasks is enormous, and understanding the broad range of tasks that robots could do requires making our models available for these tasks.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pi.website/blog/api-beta

item.description:
